16. Right panel: from each of the 30 red dots, draw a thin vertical dotted gray (#AAAAAA) line rising to one colored dot (green #7FFF00, cyan #00E5E5, or tan #E8C88A); arrange the colored dots as an increasing diagonal staircase from lower-left to upper-right.
